name: inherited_method
source: class A { value() { return "A"; } } class B < A {} print B().value();

name: override_method
source: class A { value() { return "A"; } } class B < A { value() { return "B"; } } print A().value(); print B().value();

name: super_method_call
source: class A { value() { return "A"; } } class B < A { value() { return super.value()+"B"; } } print B().value();

name: super_retains_receiver
source: class A { get() { return this.x; } } class B < A { init() { this.x=7; } get() { return super.get(); } } print B().get();
requirement: Super method is bound to the current instance

name: inherited_initializer
source: class A { init(x) { this.x=x; } } class B < A {} print B(4).x;

name: multi_level_inheritance
source: class A { value() { return "A"; } } class B < A {} class C < B {} print C().value();

name: super_uses_lexical_superclass
source: class A { value() { return "A"; } } class B < A { value() { return "B"; } base() { return super.value(); } } class C < B {} print C().base();
requirement: Inherited method retains its defining superclass binding

name: missing_super_method
source: class A {} class B < A { value() { return super.missing(); } } B().value();
